description: Lines 1452-1463: 'if nc_constrained_types & NC_TYPE_RFC822 != 0 { if let Some(permitted) = nc_permitted { ... } }' is inside a loop over AVAs and again inside a loop over RDNs. The nc_permitted check is invariant across all iterations — it never changes inside this loop. The result: the same Option is unwrapped on every emailAddress AVA found. This should be hoisted to before the loop: 'let permitted_rfc822 = nc_permitted.and_then(|p| ...filter rfc822 entries...);' computed once. In practice chains have ≤5 email AVAs so the cost is trivial, but the structural issue is that an invariant condition is re-evaluated in a loop.
title: nc_permitted unwrapped inside inner loop per email attribute
